answer_1.quote: Image captioning models provide an opportunity to generate such accessibility descriptions at scale...

answer_2.quote: The metric is simply the proportion of images in Concadia where the description is assigned a higher score than the caption.

answer_4.quote: Participants rated the quality of the image descriptions along four dimensions, summarized below. Overall The overall value of the description as an alt-text description of the image. Imaginability How well the participant can visualize the image given the text description... Relevance Whether the description includes relevant details from the image, given the context in which the image appears... Irrelevance Whether the description avoids irrelevant details from the image, given the context of in which the image appears.
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated the descriptions on four dimensions: Overall, Imaginability, Relevance, and Irrelevance.
